metadata.description: Open source Agent Skills from The AIE Network for Claude Code and Cowork — practical, source-backed tools for people doing real work with AI. Writing, writing room, newsletter, editorial, direct-response, web, social, chief-of-staff, skill-creator, and video bundles.

plugins.name: ai-slop-killer
plugins.description: The final anti-AI-slop editing pass for any prose. Detects documented AI writing tells, scores the passage, rewrites in place, and proves what it caught. Configurable per house style.

plugins.name: aie-web
plugins.description: Nine focused web skills — SEO/AEO audit, site health audit, performance, pre-launch QA, defensive security review, link checking, form wiring, UX review, and automated Playwright testing. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: aie-social
plugins.description: Research-driven social post generators for LinkedIn and X. Real research phase with cited sources, proven hooks and platform-tuned formatting, a quality rubric, and a final ai-slop-killer pass.

plugins.name: aie-chief-of-staff
plugins.description: Your morning chief of staff. One prioritized daily brief from your calendar, inbox (read-only triage), and a scan of your industry news + tracked competitors. Read-only and safe by default; configurable per industry via cos.config.md.

plugins.name: aie-skill-creator
plugins.description: Build a new, high-quality Claude Agent Skill from scratch — frontmatter, tight SKILL.md, progressive-disclosure reference files, a self-test, and packaging as a .skill or plugin. Also audits and improves existing skills and fixes descriptions that don't trigger.

plugins.name: aie-video
plugins.description: BETA. Turn a recorded webinar into a publish-ready YouTube video — pull the recording off the platform, cut filler words and the dead cold open using word-level transcript timing plus audio-energy boundaries, build a thumbnail that survives at 168px, generate chapters by OCR-ing the slides, and upload private for review. Verifies itself by re-transcribing the render.

plugins.name: aie-direct-response
plugins.description: Three evidence-led direct-response skills for copy review, sales pages, VSLs, webinars, and promotional email launches. Supports supplied brand voice, proof ledgers, accessibility, compliance checks, and explicit release states.

plugins.name: aie-writing-room
plugins.description: A fiction writing room: an orchestrator that runs a draft through planning, drafting, character, technical, realism, continuity, and voice passes in a fixed order, ending with ai-slop-killer. Every book-specific rule lives in writing-room.config.md.

plugins.name: aie-newsletter
plugins.description: Five newsletter production skills: news digest, tutorial, single-tactic edition, deep dive, and community/events roundup. Research with cited sources, fixed structures, 100-point review rubrics, and staging to a file or your CMS.

plugins.name: aie-editorial
plugins.description: Build and write in a voice profile from someone's transcripts, enforce a configurable house style, run a developmental edit with an editorial letter, and explain AI concepts with 1980s pop culture analogies.
